summary: Connect climate scenarios, financed emissions, and portfolio controls. Explore this practical five-day financial-institution course.
lede: Climate risk governance connects physical hazards and transition drivers to financial-institution portfolio decisions. For climate-risk, credit-risk, and portfolio professionals, the training develops practical ways to map exposures, assess scenario assumptions, and calculate financed-emissions indicators. Participants also practise turning findings into portfolio actions, governance controls, escalation measures, and board or IFRS S2 reporting inputs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for financial-institution professionals who make, oversee, analyse, or report climate-related portfolio decisions across lending, investment, insurance, and risk functions.
modules: NGFS Scenario Analysis and Stress Testing
Risk Appetite, Targets, and Transition Plans
prerequisites: Working familiarity with at least one financial-institution function such as credit, investment, insurance, risk, finance, sustainability, or portfolio analysis is expected. No coding or programming is required.
